sections.title: Overview
sections.content: First Strike is a Pictos in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Effect: Increases damage on the first hit of a battle.

sections.title: Effect
sections.content: Increases damage on the first hit of a battle.

sections.title: How to Get First Strike
sections.content: Location: Stone Wave Cliffs - Paintress Shrine, grapple east.

sections.title: Is It Worth Equipping?
sections.content: Pictos unlock a Lumina after four battles, so equipping it once is enough to keep the effect permanently available for the Lumina cost.
